name: client-quotes
purpose: The client-stories band: a framed `quote-tabs` carousel of customer quotes, each signed by its author and marked by the client's logo, with one call to action under it. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'client-quotes', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `quote-tabs` and `button`.
useWhen: To let several customers speak in turn, one at a time, near the end of a page's argument.
avoidWhen: For one quote beside a logo wall → use `logo-wall-quote`.
For a scrolling strip of analyst recognitions → use `recognition-marquee`.
related: quote-tabs` — the tabbed quote carousel this band frames.
bestPractices: Three to six items; the tabs need room for each client's mark.
Give each item either a registry `mark` or a `logo` URL with `clientName`, not both.

Every item needs its quotation (`text`): a card is a tab that features it, and an item without one is skipped. Do not invent a quotation to fill the wall; list the clients you have quotes for, or use `logo-wall-quote` for one quotation beside a logo wall.

The band advances on a timer like azion.com's. Set `:autoplay="false"` when the page must hold one quote (a still capture, a page with other moving content), and bind `v-model` (the selected index) to open on a quote other than the first; never wrap or re-time the band yourself.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the quote carousel.

props.name: items
props.doc: The quotes, in order; each is `{ text, name?, jobTitle?, mark?, logo?, clientName?, photo? }` where `mark` is a registry mark name and `logo` a mark URL named by `clientName`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Button under the quotes; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Advances to the next quote on a timer, as `quote-tabs` does; pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion.

props.name: autoplayInterval
props.doc: Milliseconds each quote is held before the band advances.
